response:
I'm really glad you reached out, because what you're carrying right now is a lot—recovering from birth, caring for two young children, running on little sleep, and feeling unsupported and criticized by the person who should be your teammate. Please know that the exhaustion and low feelings you're describing are common after birth, and being told you're not doing enough while you're stretched this thin is genuinely unfair to you.

A few things matter here. Threats to leave you "alone" as a way to control or punish you are not okay, and none of this is a reflection of your worth. Please consider talking to your doctor or midwife about how you're feeling emotionally—postpartum depression is real and treatable. Reaching out to a trusted friend or family member for practical and emotional support can also lighten the load.

If you ever feel unsafe or in crisis, please contact a local crisis line or emergency services. You deserve support and care too.
